name: programmatic-seo
description: For template-based SEO pages built from a dataset (a page per city, tool, integration or product), not programmatic advertising. Checks from your rows which entries have enough facts of their own to deserve a page and which should share one, specifies the page template, checks pasted sample pages for near-duplicates and thin text, and plans a batched launch with stop rules. Each verdict comes with the table that decided it. It does not write the pages or estimate search volume.

interface.shortDescription: Which dataset rows deserve an SEO page
interface.longDescription: Four skills for template-based SEO pages built from a dataset, not programmatic advertising. Viability groups rows with identical facts, checks that each group differs from the others on facts a reader acts on, and says build all, build some (with the page list) or one hub page instead. Template spec turns a chosen page type into a block table, how much of each page must change per row, banned blocks, noindex and merge rules, and a block map for one row. Sample check removes the shared template from pasted pages, ignores the swapped name and prints a similarity matrix with near-duplicate and thin flags. Rollout plans the hierarchy, sitemap split and pilot batch, and says continue or stop from the batch counts you type. It never writes the pages, never estimates search volume and works only on data you paste.
defaultPrompt: Page per tool? tool,fee,days,currencies,api / Acme,1.2%,2,3,y / Globex,1.2%,2,3,y / Initech,0.9%,5,12,n / Umbra,0.7%,1,8,n
Spec a template for 'Northwind Ledger vs {competitor}' pages. Columns: competitor, fee, payout_days, currencies, api
Rollout for 800 integration pages: batch 1 published 40, indexed 15, 6 indexed with zero impressions. Continue or stop?
